mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 3% signals weakening household demand, which reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns remain positive in more than 70% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during high inflation regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the industrial production index exceeding 2% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5 percentage points signals a tightening monetary cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points and a decline in nonfarm payrolls above 50,000 signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) exceeding 15% signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 4% signals strengthening household demand, which boosts earnings growth expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered episodes (t-test p > 0.10).
